<!-- pr-reviewer: b3733f46c348f9146747d1d05a1cc91f4099604c -->
Needs changes before merge.

The corner and centre picks use the existing undoable WCS commands. Box markers keep priority. A missing vertex gives an error and adds no command. No golden files or snapshot PNG files changed.

I ran the checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-1710`, with the PR merged into upstream main `c785c14bd1c726d0042b7c5b98f0a13d5b7b5a5d` for this test only. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

Results:
- UI library build (`cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib --no-run`): passed.
- UI library tests, from `crates/ui`: 785 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored. The failed test was `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. This machine has no graphics adapter. The error was:
  ```text
  egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found
  ```
- App library: 305 passed, 1 ignored.
- App suites: `plane_align` 9 passed; `wcs_align` 5 passed; `wcs_view_pose` 3 passed; `winding_align` 8 passed, 1 failed.
- The failed winding test, `the_inside_out_stl_fixture_reads_inside_out_and_refuses`, also failed on unchanged upstream main at the SHA above. This is an existing failure at `crates/app/tests/winding_align.rs:189`:
  ```text
  assertion `left == right` failed
    left: [Outward]
   right: [InsideOut]
  ```
- UI suites: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 6 passed; `sinker_setup` 1 passed; `theme_files` 14 passed.
- Clippy (`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`): passed.

I used the safety checks for this review because these picks set the WCS origin. The PR does not change the post, collision checks, gouge checks, stock simulation, or geometry algorithms. I repeated two of the stated mutations:
- Remove the vertex arm: the corner placement and undo test failed at `wcs_part_point_tests.rs:49`.
- Remove the centre arm: the boss centre test failed at `wcs_part_point_tests.rs:68`.
After I restored the source byte for byte, all 4 new tests passed. The worktree had no source changes. There were no moved goldens to check.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page.rs:161` and the PR body: add before and after screenshots to the PR body. Show the WCS page and viewport with the new corner and centre targets. The body says that screenshots were not exercised and contains no screenshots. This UI change needs that evidence.

The graphics test and the existing winding failure limit local test coverage. They are not new defects from this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Added before and after screenshots to the PR body for the corner and boss rim centre picks. Each capture shows the WCS page and the real GPU viewport. The before captures use the parent picker behavior and hint. The after captures show G54 at the clicked target.

Pinned by `review_1710_wcs_page_and_viewport_evidence`. Reverting the picker made the origin assertion RED. Restoring it made the test GREEN. Quick gate and clippy on camcraft-ui and camcraft-app passed.

New head: `4bfb4b5a599a805a992151cd9d60c23d1df1bb4c`.

Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4bfb4b5a599a805a992151cd9d60c23d1df1bb4c -->
Source review clean. The branch has conflicts with main.

The new picks use the existing undoable WCS commands. Box markers keep priority. A missing vertex gives an error and adds no command. I checked all four before and after screenshots in the PR body. They show the WCS page, viewport, and expected origin values. The screenshot request from the previous review is complete. No new source defect was found.

I ran the checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-1710`. No GitHub runner was used. The trial merge with upstream main `e2f012e90c3174fb308344e5122bb39e70531d90` failed in these files:
- `crates/app/src/pick/align.rs:193`: main splits the vertex function into a wrapper and `vertex_with_pose`; this PR makes the vertex function public.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:5199`: the new evidence module conflicts with the end of the file on main.

I aborted the merge and tested the PR head. These results do not prove that the merged code passes.

Results:
- UI library build: passed.
- UI library tests, from `crates/ui`: 777 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored. The only failure was `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1792`. This machine has no graphics adapter:
  ```text
  egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found
  ```
- App library: 303 passed, 1 ignored.
- App suites: `plane_align` 9 passed; `wcs_align` 5 passed; `wcs_view_pose` 3 passed; `winding_align` 9 passed. The winding failure from the previous review did not occur in this run.
- UI suites: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 6 passed; `sinker_setup` 1 passed; `theme_files` 14 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I used the safety checks because the picks set the WCS origin. The PR does not change the post, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry algorithms. I repeated two stated mutations:
- Remove the vertex arm: RED. The corner placement and undo test failed at `wcs_part_point_tests.rs:49`.
- Remove the centre arm: RED. The boss centre test failed at `wcs_part_point_tests.rs:68`.
- Restore the source byte for byte: GREEN. All four new tests passed. The worktree had no source changes.

No golden files or snapshot goldens changed. There were no moved goldens to check. The manual evidence capture test was left ignored because it requires a graphics adapter.

No source changes are requested by this review. The merge conflicts must be resolved at merge time under the repository rules. The merged result still needs its checks. The graphics test limits local test coverage; it is not a new defect from this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The latest review asks only for conflict resolution and checks of the merged result.

I merged upstream main fe1a94c7778279fecbb2f1135d64e046dd3b1dba locally. The vertex wrapper stays public and keeps main's vertex_with_pose helper. The evidence test module stays registered.

Both resolutions passed mutation checks. Making vertex private gave E0603; restoring it passed all four WCS part-point tests. Removing the evidence module removed its test from discovery; restoring it brought the test back. The plane_align, wcs_align, and wcs_view_pose suites passed all 17 tests.

Stopped without a push under the resolve-conflicts skill's red-check rule. Quick gate is RED only because headless_run_succeeds cannot find a graphics adapter. UI had 800 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored. App had 311 passed, 1 ignored. All seven integration suites passed.

Clippy is RED on macOS in unchanged upstream crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs: PNG_256 at line 12 and taskbar_icon at line 40 are unused. I did not change unrelated code.

The local merge is retained on branch fix-1710 at 26c1e48a8a0433ddb9da8439913bc8310a571c2f. The PR head remains 4bfb4b5a599a805a992151cd9d60c23d1df1bb4c. No labels or ready status changed.

Main was merged into this branch. The new head is 8e8e3cd6.

Two files conflicted.

- `crates/app/src/pick/align.rs`: main added `vertex_with_pose` and made `vertex` `pub(crate)`. This branch keeps `vertex` `pub`, because `wcs_circle_pick.rs` in the UI crate calls it. I kept the main code and the `pub` on `vertex`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`: both sides added a line at the end of the file. I kept both lines, including `mod review_1710_evidence;`.

No snapshot PNG or changelog file changed.

Tests run:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: green (app and ui suites).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Delta class: DELTA (a conflict was resolved by hand). A delta review of the remerge-diff is needed. The PR is ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8e8e3cd6d3d13f26bf899446fca1c3b78f95c4b0 -->
Source review clean. Ready for the maintainer to merge, with the local check limits below.

I checked the merge conflict resolutions against the previous reviewed head. The public vertex wrapper keeps main's `vertex_with_pose` helper and uses `setup_align::view_pose`. This is the active setup frame that the viewport draws and picks. The WCS origin pick needs that frame. The evidence test module is still registered. The previous requests from NeoTech are complete.

The picks use the existing undoable WCS commands. Box markers keep priority. A missing vertex gives an error and adds no command. I checked all four before and after screenshots in the PR body. They show the WCS page, viewport, and expected origin values. No golden files or snapshot goldens changed.

I ran the checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-1710`. No GitHub runner was used. The trial merge with upstream main `ca603fc418e130f8ce2a9eac7e9b41e45609c008` was already up to date: this PR head contains that main commit. The worktree had no source changes after the checks.

Results:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: app passed; UI failed only in `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` because this machine has no graphics adapter.
- App library: 313 passed, 1 ignored. App suites: `plane_align` 9 passed; `wcs_align` 5 passed; `winding_align` 9 passed.
- UI library, from `crates/ui`: 805 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored. UI suites: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 6 passed; `sinker_setup` 1 passed; `theme_files` 14 passed.
- Additional `wcs_view_pose` suite: 3 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: failed on two unused items in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs`: `PNG_256` at line 12 and `taskbar_icon` at line 40. That file is identical to upstream main. These macOS errors are outside this PR's changes.

Exact check errors:
```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found
error: constant `PNG_256` is never used
error: function `taskbar_icon` is never used
```

I used the safety checks because these picks set the WCS origin. This PR changes no post, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation, or geometry algorithm. I repeated two stated mutations:
- Remove the vertex arm: RED. The corner and undo test failed at `wcs_part_point_tests.rs:49`.
- Remove the centre arm: RED. The boss centre test failed at `wcs_part_point_tests.rs:68`.
- Restore the source byte for byte: GREEN. All four new tests passed.

There were no moved goldens to check. The manual evidence capture test stayed ignored because it needs a graphics adapter.

Requested before merge: none. The local gate and clippy are not fully green for the reasons above. These limits do not indicate a new defect in this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: 8e8e3cd6d3d13f26bf899446fca1c3b78f95c4b0 -->

**Estimated agent cost:** ~$0.39 (71k tokens, estimate)

Model: session default. Route: local delta review of the remerge-diff (`align.rs`, `tests.rs`) in the reviewer's own worktree; quick gate on the merged tree plus clippy. No runner used.

Blended upper estimate at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower.
